title: Spicy Chickpea Stir Fry
description: A savory and spicy stir fry made with chickpeas, Eastern flavors, and a hint of Chinese spices. Serve over steamed rice for a delicious and filling meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chickpeas, soy sauce, and middle eastern spice blend. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, or until the chickpeas are coated in the sauce.
Stir in the hummus and cook for an additional minute.
Serve hot over steamed rice and garnish with chopped green onions.
